notes.title: Announcing Space Menace 2 | Wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=tl1KC2JHnnY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi there everyone,
I'm thrilled to announce my upcoming sci-fi space RTS and battle game, Space Menace 2, now available to wishlist! A heartfelt thank you to all the players of the original Space Menace—your invaluable feedback made this sequel possible.

Space Menace 2 thrusts you into a galaxy on the brink of chaos, where every decision you make shapes the future of the stars. As a space captain, you’ll start with a small, modest fleet, but your journey is anything but ordinary. With the freedom to chart your own course, you'll engage in freelance missions, trade, and battles, earning the credits needed to expand and upgrade your fleet.

Rise to Power
As you rise through the ranks, the stakes grow higher. Initially commanding just a few ships, you'll soon find yourself in control of powerful fleets, gaining the trust and respect of the galaxy's most formidable factions. Align yourself wisely, for your reputation will grant you unprecedented power, from commanding faction fleets to eventually leading entire factions as their supreme leader.

Customize
Customization is key in Space Menace 2. Tailor your fleet with deep loadouts, selecting from a wide array of weapons, utilities, and strike craft to create the perfect combination for your strategic needs. And with mod support, the game allows you to personalize your experience even further, adding new layers of content and possibilities.

Maximum Excitement, Minimal Grind
Space Menace 2 is designed for maximum excitement with minimal grind, offering a deep, strategic experience that evolves as you do. As the game unfolds, so do the challenges and complexities, ensuring every moment is filled with tactical decisions and thrilling encounters. Whether you're outmaneuvering enemy fleets or negotiating with powerful allies, your choices will echo through the galaxy, leaving a legacy that only you can forge.

Wishlist Space Menace 2 now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136380/Space_Menace_2/

notes.title: Changelog
notes.content:
v4.1.2 - March 04, 2024

 Implemented subtle adjustments to alleviate the sense of grind and provide a more accessible entry into the game. This includes a slight reduction in the prices of class 1 and 2 ships, a decrease in the research point requirements for research tasks, shorter research durations, and an increase in credits awarded upon completing missions.
 Minor bug fixes.


v4.1.1 - February 05, 2024

 The Athon Federation icon was changed because the previous icon was very similar to another faction's icon, causing confusion.
 Minor bug fixes.


v4.1.0 - February 01, 2024

 Added an option for users to customize the colors of certain UI elements, with a focus on enhancing accessibility for individuals with color blindness.
 Minor bug fixes.


v4.0.9 - October 20, 2023

 Improved graphics with the help of multiple lights.
 Various bug fixes.


July 29, 2023

 Various bug fixes and minor changes.


July 23, 2023

 Minor bug fixes.


July 22, 2023

 Minor bug fixes.


June 26, 2023

 Added an option to invert the cursor.
 Minor bug fixes.


June 22, 2023

 Fixed some bugs that were causing game crashes.
 Minor bug fixes.


June 17, 2023

 Added multiple save slots.
 Enhanced UI/UX in select areas for a more intuitive experience.
 Various bug fixes and changes.


June 03, 2023

 You can now befriend a hostile faction in a sector by offering them credits.
 Various bug fixes.


May 24, 2023

 Fixed a bug that prevented ships from attacking remaining enemy fighters and loot was not automatically collected after completing a mission.
 Fixed a bug that hid the contents of the Objectives page.
 Minor bug fixes.


May 13, 2023

 New class 4 ship, which is now the fastest ship in the game.
 Increased the speed of fighters and fixed a bug that prevented fighters from chasing ships.
 Minor bug fixes and changes.


May 9, 2023

 Added an option to scrap modules directly from the Loadouts page, making it easier for you to manage your inventory.
 Fixed several bugs that were causing the game to become unresponsive. For example, you should no longer experience issues when clicking buttons during hyperspace travel in the starmap, or when attempting to interact with buttons at the start of a scene load.
 Minor bug fixes.


May 6, 2023

 Fixed a bug related to research points not generating correctly.
 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Changelog
notes.content:
April 30, 2023

 New ship upgrade module. Hangar bay accelerator.
 Adjusted game mechanics so that fewer non-player ships spawn, but can now pose a greater threat by directly targeting carrier ships and ignoring fighters.
 Various bug fixes.


April 20, 2023

 Implemented system for collecting log files.


April 18, 2023

 Increased energy recharge speed of all ships.
 Various bug fixes.


April 15, 2023

 Added 3 new class 5 ships. Aegis, Executioner and Hive.
 New Module Type: Ship Upgrade Module. 4 of these modules are now available. Hull Booster, Speed Booster, Shield Regen and Energy Regen.
 Fixed point defense modules bug. Now they should work much better.
 Various bug fixes and changes.


April 10, 2023

 Fixed bugs related to the Module Shop and a bug where you cannot purchase the fighter Modules.


April 01, 2023

 Fixed a bug where the repair beam was not working on some ships.
 Fixed a bug where fighter research points were not generated.


April 01, 2023

 Updated ships stats.
 Now the number of fighter ships will be determined by the hangar modules instead of the carrier ship. Some carrier ships now have multiple hangar modules.
 New small ship missile bombers.
 Changed the appearance of all small ships.
 Various bug fixes and changes.


April 01, 2023

 Fixed some bugs related to PD beam lasers. Now they should work much better.
 Minor bug fixes and changes.


March 30, 2023

 You can now see the faction of the fighters by clicking on it.
 Added a research to increase the sensor range in the star map to show information about more distant sectors.
 Ships will now initiate a hyper jump instantly if there are no hostile ships in the sector. Let me know if you like it or not or if I can improve it.
 Minor bug fixes and changes.


March 26, 2023

 Fixed a bug related to research.
 Minor bug fixes.


March 25, 2023

 Fixed a bug that prevented the user from purchasing Tier 1 modules.
 Various bug fixes and changes.


March 15, 2023

 New advance tractor beam module.
 Introducing station level. The higher the level of a station, the better the modules you can find there.
 You can now see the station level and possible faction conflict locations in the starmap.

March 08, 2023

 New serpent missile module.
 Introducing a new module type, special grade weapons.
 Limited number of missiles and special grade modules that each ship can equip.
 Various bug fixes and changes.


February 27, 2023

 New escort freelance mission.

January 02, 2023

 Minor bug fixes.


January 01, 2023

 The bug of texts not appearing is fixed.


December 26, 2022

 Minor bug fixes and changes.


December 25, 2022

 Changed the code for receiving loot. It should fix some bugs or introduce new ones 🙃.
 Fixed a bug related to total play time not saving correctly.
 Fixed bugs related to hull, shield, etc. of the ship that were not saving correctly.
 Minor bug fixes and changes.


December 22, 2022

 Fixed a bug related to ship selection.
 Made changes to the Mission and Objectives page and added rewards.
 Minor bug fixes and changes.


December 20, 2022

 Added option to change the intensity of the bloom effect and the option to disable it completely or just for the UI.

December 18, 2022

notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
Hello there,
On November 7, I released a big game update that added new contents to the game. To see these new contents, you must completely defeat any faction in the game (except pirates). As always, all feedbacks/suggestions/ideas are most welcome. Feel free to report any bugs you encounter.

Thank you very much 👍
